Gamino's recipe for a decent cheap burger that is essentially fool proof.

  • 50grams or more of mushrooms (any will do), two red onions, 3-4 slices of decent bacon (ideally smoked but not important) chop all and fry. once browning starts add a teaspoon of sugar (brown ideally) and once its started to caramelize add some water to deglaze the pan, take off the heat and let it cool.
  • once your fried mix is cooled add to your mince, mix though then add water. If you don't use lean mince then a lot of fat will stick to your hand(s) and sides of your bowl, this is okay. You can add spices at this stage like some cracked black pepper, chopped chili, table spoon of cayenne pepper, or my favorite dried smokey BBQ mix (old el paso or whatever).   • Make into burgers as large as you want, it should feel really soft yet consistent in your hand before it goes into the pan, add a little more water if its not.   • burger should be tender, overflowing with juice (adding water during mixing actually drives out a little fat but helps it stay tender), I like to have mine with some fried cherry tomatoes, a couple slices of smokey bacon, a little thinly sliced raw onion, toasted bun, and a simple sauce of mayo + cayenne pepper + sugar (or maple syrup) whisked.
